page.content:
Last battle, where Arthur and Mordred strike each other down.

How Battle of Camlann connects

  • Character: King Arthur — Arthur receives his mortal wound at Camlann.
  • Character: Mordred — Mordred is slain at Camlann as he wounds Arthur.

What is Battle of Camlann?

Camlann is the end of the earthly reign: civil war after the Lancelot rupture, Mordred's usurpation, and the wounding that sends Arthur to Avalon.

Key threads lead to King Arthur and Mordred.
